title: The same integrity audit, applied to the three remaining cohorts: Yeast 4825, GitHub 992, Digital swarm (pre-registered BEFORE running)
purpose: The knowledge-cohort audit (PR #111) retracted a real-world claim (the N=793 fixture is synthetic) and falsified a pre-registered thesis. Consistency demands the SAME audit be applied to the three cohorts that were NOT audited: Yeast N=4825, GitHub N=992, and the digital swarm. This experiment does two things at once: (a) it classifies each cohort's evidentiary status -- REAL-and-reproducible, SIMULATION, or NOT-OFFLINE-REPRODUCIBLE -- and (b) it runs the subset of the laws that the committed data can actually support. Anything the repository cannot back offline is declared as a gap, not asserted.
terminology_note: Functional/engineering terms only, no cultural or religious lexicon: capacity U, encoding fidelity D_enc, decoding fidelity D_dec, realized outcome E, two-source independence (VIF), enforcement latency tau_v.

provenance_findings_declared_before_test.yeast_4825: REAL and committed: repro/data/4932.protein.physical.links.v12.0.csv.gz (STRING v12, taxon 4932, combined_score>=400) yields 4825 proteins / 70201 edges, and the derived per-node channel features are frozen in biomedical-agency/data/yeast_channel_frozen.json. HOWEVER the gene-essentiality LABELS are NOT committed anywhere in this repository (no DEG essential-gene file, no ORF name map). Therefore any outcome-coupling claim on yeast -- specifically the reported linear-vs-quadratic result 'delta AIC ~ -1805, quadratic AUC ~0.47' -- is NOT offline-reproducible here. The CHANNEL INVARIANTS are reproducible; the OUTCOME COUPLING is not.
provenance_findings_declared_before_test.github_992: NOT OFFLINE-REPRODUCIBLE. No 992-row dataset is committed. lism-cohorts/results_meta.json records N=992 with a split '750 fail / 242 survive' and a verdict 'linear AUC ~0.73, quad CV AUC ~0.59, VIF 1.003', but stores only a spec HASH, not the rows. What IS committed and real: repro/tauv_cohort.json -- 21 real GitHub repositories with server-computed tau_v (mean capped issue-close latency, days) and a real lifecycle label E (0=failed, 1=survived), split 4 failed / 17 survived; and github-lism/data/github_cohort_frozen.json -- 28 real repositories with metadata but no survival label.
provenance_findings_declared_before_test.digital_swarm: SIMULATION, not a real-world cohort. validation-stages/stage3_swarm.py states in its own docstring 'Layer-1, stdlib only, seeded, offline. Reads nothing gated; simulates the swarm.' Its committed result is n_nodes=500 over max_depth=39 from a fixed seed. It is a seeded model of agent-to-agent fidelity decay, and carries ZERO real-world measurement weight. hf-cohort/swarm/ separately combines REAL Hugging Face lineage metadata with a simulated propagation process.

gates.C1_yeast_channel_independence_REAL: REAL DATA. On the real yeast interactome (N=4825), the two fidelity hops must be independent: measured VIF(D_enc=clustering, D_dec=min-max betweenness) < 1.10, reproducing the reported VIF ~ 1.003. Deterministic control: a collinear clone (D_dec := D_enc) must be REJECTED at VIF >= 5.0. PASS iff both. This is the part of the yeast claim the repository CAN back.
gates.C2_yeast_outcome_coupling_NOT_REPRODUCIB: DECLARED GAP. Verify programmatically that NO gene-essentiality label source exists in the repository (search for a committed essentiality/DEG label file keyed to yeast ORFs). PASS iff the absence is confirmed and recorded, so the non-reproducibility of the 'delta AIC ~ -1805 / AUC 0.47' outcome claim is entered into the permanent record rather than repeated. This gate PASSES BY CORRECTLY DETECTING A GAP; it is not evidence for or against the underlying science.
gates.C3_github_tau_v_separation_REAL: REAL DATA, UNDERPOWERED (declared). On the 21 real repositories with real lifecycle labels, does enforcement latency tau_v separate failed from survived? Compute the rank-based AUC of tau_v discriminating failed (E=0) from survived (E=1). DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION: failed repositories have HIGHER tau_v, i.e. AUC > 0.5. FALSIFIABLE: AUC <= 0.5 falsifies the direction and must be reported. DECLARED UP FRONT: with only 4 failures this is severely underpowered -- even a positive result is WEAK evidence and must be labelled as such, and no p-value or confidence claim will be manufactured from it.
gates.C4_github_992_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: DECLARED GAP. Verify programmatically that no committed artifact contains 992 labelled repository rows. PASS iff the absence is confirmed and recorded, and the actually-available real alternatives (N=21 labelled tau_v cohort; N=28 unlabelled frozen cohort) are reported in its place. The reported 'N=992, 750 fail / 242 survive, linear AUC ~0.73' is therefore NOT backed by committed data and must not be cited as offline-reproducible. Gate PASSES BY CORRECTLY DETECTING THE GAP.
gates.C5_swarm_linear_vs_quadratic_SIMULATION: SIMULATION ONLY, ZERO REAL-WORLD EVIDENCE. Re-run the seeded swarm model and confirm it is labelled a simulation, that fidelity decays with hop depth, and that the linear coupling fits at least as well as the quadratic (r2_linear >= r2_quadratic). PASS iff the simulation reproduces bit-stably from its fixed seed AND is correctly labelled as carrying no real-world weight. A simulation reproducing itself is a code-correctness check, NOT empirical support for the law.
gates.C6_integrity_ledger: CROSS-COHORT LEDGER. Emit an explicit evidentiary classification for every cohort in the LISM programme -- REAL_REPRODUCIBLE, SIMULATION, or NOT_OFFLINE_REPRODUCIBLE -- including the already-retracted knowledge cohort. PASS iff the ledger is emitted, every cohort carries a status, and the count of NOT_OFFLINE_REPRODUCIBLE cohorts is >= 1 (i.e. the audit is not whitewashing itself).

symmetric_null: Every measured value -- the yeast VIF, the tau_v AUC, the swarm r2 pair -- is reported AS-IS. C3 is genuinely falsifiable and may come out against the prediction. C2 and C4 are gap-detection gates: they pass by finding an absence, and finding the absence is a NEGATIVE result about the repository's evidence base, reported at full force. No gate may be retuned after seeing results, and no cohort's status may be upgraded without committing the underlying data.
acceptance: GREEN when the spec re-hashes to the manifest, the committed fixtures re-hash to their pins, and C1-C6 are evaluated exactly as written -- with the two declared gaps recorded rather than papered over. Exit 0 means 'the audit reproduces, including its gaps', NOT 'all cohort claims are supported'.
honest_scope: This audit does NOT disprove the LISM mathematics, and it does not claim the original yeast or GitHub analyses were wrong -- they may well have been run correctly against data that simply was never committed here. It establishes precisely what THIS repository can and cannot substantiate offline, which is the only thing a reproducibility claim can honestly rest on. Methodology, not speed; the gaps are the finding.
